records.trigger: The two REVIEW-path gates never consult the item-level withdrawal helper, so a confirmed user-approved withdrawal still has evidence and dispatch records demanded for it.
records.observedFailure: Executed unit-level probe against the compiled gate. withdrawnChecklistItemIdsFrom(decision) correctly resolves the withdrawn set to [CHK-002] for a decision with decision=confirmed and userConfirmed=true, yet checkDispatchEvidence returns ok=false with issues=[CHK-002] - it still demands dispatch evidence for that item. Its opts are {checklist, events, mainAgentOwnedItems} and carry no decision record at all, so it cannot consult the withdrawal even in principle. CONTROL: the delivered CHK-001, which has dispatch evidence, is correctly NOT an offender, so the gate is discriminating rather than failing everything. Independently corroborated in production on story B-8df9, where the same defect produced two live refusals: review_completeness_missing_evidence naming CHK-004 happy/edge/adversarial, and "CHK-004 has no dispatch/subagent_result evidence".
records.note: Pre-DEV probe recorded before any fix, at baseline HEAD. CHK-001 formalizes this into a registered artifact under packages/main/tests/red/ that also covers evaluateReviewCompleteness and the four anti-bypass cases.
